args.message: ENG-91: add deprecation headers per API guidelines

args.body:
## Summary
Implement ENG-91: api.headers.deprecation_headers(sunset_date) following the Notion API guidelines (page 5e6f-guidelines, Deprecation section).

Returns exactly:
- Deprecation: true
- Sunset: the supplied HTTP-date string
- Link: <https://developer.acme.example/migrate>; rel="deprecation"

The existing signature accepts a string; the helper preserves the supplied HTTP-date without inventing a date or adding undocumented conversion rules.

## Verification
Ran locally: python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
Result: all 3 tests passed (exact headers, Sunset preservation, independent dictionaries).

## Tool limitations
GitHub file reads and code searches returned empty results, and HTTPS git access was unavailable. Implementation used the supplied local repository source. Branch creation and push APIs reported success; remote contents require verification.
